description: Dedicated security pass over a change or feature: trust boundaries, authn/z, input handling, secrets, injection, and dependency risk. Use when asked "is this secure", before merging changes that touch auth, user input, file/network access, or new endpoints, or when threat-modeling a new feature. Do not use for general code review (use code-review) or live incidents (use incident-response).
